lower-third.description: Lower third: a name or topic in the bottom-left corner. Params: title, subtitle, color.

callout.description: Callout: a short note with an accent edge, placed anywhere. Params: text, color, x, y (pixels of the top-left corner on a 1920x1080 frame).

title-card.description: Title card: a large centred title over a dark fade, for chapter breaks. Params: title, subtitle, color.

subscribe.description: Subscribe button: pops up, gets clicked, and the bell rings. Params: text, color, x, y (pixels of its middle).

highlight.description: Highlight box: a rounded outline draws itself around part of the screen, with a soft glow. Params: color, x, y, w, h (pixels on a 1920x1080 frame).

arrow.description: Arrow: a curved arrow swoops in and points at a spot, with an optional label. Params: text, color, x, y (pixels of the arrow tip).

step.description: Step: a numbered badge with a line of text, for walkthroughs. Params: number, text, color.

keys.description: Keyboard shortcut: keycaps that press down one after another, e.g. Ctrl + Shift + P. Params: keys (joined with +), color.

counter.description: Counter: a big number that counts up to a value, with a label under it. Params: value, suffix, label, color.

quote.description: Quote: a large quotation with who said it, over a darkened picture. Params: text, author, color.

defaults.text: The best way to predict the future is to build it.

end-card.description: End card: a closing screen with a title and two boxes where YouTube end-screen videos go. Params: title, subtitle, color.
